title: Transmitter Days x/60.1?
symptom: The display for 'Transmitter Days' changed from showing only the days running to showing '33/60.1'. The user expects the transmitter to last at least 90 days and asks what '60.1' means.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. The user speculates that switching transmitters (from an 8J to an 81xxx and back) may have caused the display to show remnants from the 81 transmitter, as later it shows '69/69/69.0'.
evidence_quote: Obviously these are remnants from the 81 tx change. After switching to this tx again, xDrip says "69/69/69.0".
